title: 佛经详解：佛教艺术与象征 — Day 32
title_en: Sutra Deep Dive: Buddhist Art & Symbolism — Day 32

questions.question: 按《观无量寿佛经》揭示的造像原理，佛像的三十二相与各种手印最准确的定位是什么？
options: 观想的视觉词汇：借外在相好作所缘，唤起内在的「是心作佛」
信众礼拜祈福的对象本身，像越庄严，供奉它所得的功德也就越大
佛陀真实容貌的写实记录，靠弟子们代代口传描述才得以保存下来
画工依个人审美自由发挥的装饰，主要用来区分不同寺院风格
questions.explanation: 文章强调像是「观」的所缘而不是崇拜的偶像，次序是先有观想的需求、后有图像的法度。把像当作礼拜的终点，正是文中所说的「执像为实」。
questions.question_en: According to the principle the Contemplation Sutra reveals, what are the Buddha's thirty-two marks and hand gestures (mudras) best understood as?
options_en: A visual vocabulary for visualization—outer marks serving as supports that awaken the inner “this mind becomes Buddha”
Objects of worship in their own right; the more splendid the image, the greater the merit of venerating it
A realistic record of the Buddha's actual appearance, preserved through generations of oral description
Ornaments left to each painter's taste, used mainly to tell one monastery's style from another's
questions.explanation_en: The article stresses that images are supports for contemplation, not idols: the need to visualize came first, the iconographic rules after. Treating the image as the endpoint of worship is exactly what it calls “grasping the image as real.”

questions.question: 《造像量度经》以「指」为单位严格规定佛身比例。文章怎样看这种约束与创造的关系？
options: 以规矩证庄严：统一比例让互不相识的匠人造出一致可辨、令人起敬的相好
它是为维护宗教正统而牺牲艺术个性的代价，所以唐卡的艺术价值低于自由创作
比例来自对佛陀真身的实测，严守量度是为了让佛像在外形上忠实于历史原貌
它只在清代宫廷造像中通行，民间画师大多不依量度，凭自己眼光直接起稿
questions.explanation: 文章说量度不是束缚创造，而是大规模一致性的前提，类比设计规范让分散的团队产出可互操作的系统。把它看成牺牲个性的代价，恰是文章要反驳的直觉。
questions.question_en: The Iconometry Sutra fixes the Buddha's proportions in finger-width units. How does the article view the relationship between this constraint and creativity?
options_en: Rules bear witness to majesty: shared proportions let artisans who never met produce consistent, recognizable, awe-inspiring images
It is a price paid for orthodoxy at the expense of individuality, which is why thangka ranks below free artistic creation
The proportions were measured from the Buddha's actual body, so strict adherence keeps images historically faithful
It applied only to Qing court commissions; most folk painters ignored the measurements and sketched entirely by eye
questions.explanation_en: The article says the measurements don't fetter creativity—they are the precondition for consistency at scale, like a design system letting distributed teams build interoperable parts. Seeing them as a sacrifice of individuality is the intuition the article argues against.

questions.question: 曼荼罗以中心的大日如来统摄诸尊，中观却说一切无自性、无中心。文章如何调和这两者？
options: 曼荼罗只是寺院里装饰画，并不承载义理，所以根本谈不上与中观相互矛盾
二者本来就矛盾，密教在这一点上背离了中观，只能把它看作后起的一种民间信仰
中心大日是世俗谛上的方便施设，大日遍一切处，所谓中心恰恰无所不在
中观只破其他诸法的自性，大日如来作为宇宙的实有主宰，并不在被破的范围之内
questions.explanation: 文章用二谛化解：中观在胜义谛上破一切自性，密教的中心是世俗谛上的方便施设，执其中心为实反失密意。说大日是实有主宰，正是文章否定的读法；文章也强调曼荼罗不是装饰画。
questions.question_en: A mandala places Mahavairocana at the center of all deities, while Madhyamaka holds that nothing has inherent existence or a center. How does the article reconcile them?
options_en: The mandala is only a decorative temple painting with no doctrinal content, so no conflict with Madhyamaka arises
They genuinely conflict; esoteric Buddhism departed from Madhyamaka here and should be seen as a later folk belief
The central Buddha is a conventional-truth device; since he pervades everywhere without fixed place, the “center” is in fact everywhere
Madhyamaka refutes the inherent existence of other dharmas only; Mahavairocana as a real cosmic ruler is exempt
questions.explanation_en: The article resolves it with the two truths: Madhyamaka negates all inherent existence at the ultimate level, while the esoteric center is a skillful device at the conventional level—grasping it as real misses the point. Treating Mahavairocana as a real ruler is the reading the article rejects, and it insists the mandala is not decoration.
